final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.typesite, AVG(scans.pressratio) as avg_pressratio, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) as avg_ratio FROM scans JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref WHERE scans.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) as avg_of_pressratio, AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratio FROM step1
